newsitem.title: UK: Clarke - tax avoidance steps to save 6.7 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: Clarke - tax avoidance steps to save 6.7 bln stg.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said he expected tax avoidance measures taken in his annual budget for 1997/8 to save 6.7 billion stg in three years.

"The spend-to-save package will cost 800 million stg over the next three years to secure, in a well-planned and measured way, revenue and expenditure savings of well over eight times that amount, 6.7 billion stg," Clarke told parliament.
This package would include more Customs and Excise officers to tackle VAT and other tax abuse, he added.
